notes.title: Space logbook #06 | Demo out now go and play it!
notes.content:
[h2]Your delivery has arrived! The Underpacked! demo is now available on Steam🥳​🚀​[/h2][p][/p][p]Crewmates, the wait is over![/p][p]We are broadcasting from the main cabin of Drunken Duck Co. to announce something we've been working for months with care, memes and too much caffeine.[/p][p][/p][h3]The demo and trailer of Underpacked! are now available! [/h3][previewyoutube="Yqu8Kfay-nQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]We are very happy that our delivery crew has successfully handed off all the hard work. Now it’s your turn, crewmates, to deliver those packages successfully in Underpacked! [/p][p][/p][h3]What’s included in the demo?[/h3][list][*][p]Local co-op mode to make delivery with a friend and face the galactic gig economy together. [/p][/*][*][p]Solo mode with our helpful bot, Jul.IA, who will assist you with delivering and maintaining the ship. Keep your boss happy with flawless work![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXekXX4-QMgCzUVdBQcni0P4v-cyeBQklXv4GoXf1wkNO_oVtoTgBl5uXU3ylRekofGWHmytaivifeEzD5GqMJquznRpWuC_e0H1YTp_guqstTOLKGJQbYBPCACYGV5wxWHOGkvdBA?key=ja85VqosmQ31-t5bI4Qfj0gY"][/img][/p][list][*][p]4 exciting and challenging intergalactic levels![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeO2jshCWkfmhQBMv0Y1KvyoCX-7kT_mOpPKSzezasbK26rBvoNeyAIySX7eZJGQhdQ5ffrI4xn3Z83YKmiVnf84aafM578UKMOVgm4WF0d2NcUPwhrOsks6s7AogPlUQdtwREq0A?key=ja85VqosmQ31-t5bI4Qfj0gY"][/img][/p][h3]Get ready for Underpacked![/h3][list][*][p][b]DEFEND[/b][/p][p]Space is dangerous… Thankfully, your boss added a turret to the ship![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdp4PKqFScTbfjx4yWvT1NoeCFmUfBdBloEvMd-5kGGxUsqpCAC_q_rpmslLBrccE9d-6Ioum2VXMHBhBhdf3OKbAXESXinYPI1jfD3q3Z01ug4M6ADTIA0Yl0RhJeQovm4hEQo?key=ja85VqosmQ31-t5bI4Qfj0gY"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]PREPARE[/b] [/p][p]Handle each order and customize the package based on your client’s. Remember the package is the most important thing.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeevOByOxgWBjUwigd7ted6FudVVtNtnHrjB-Ea1h_qcri2KHcZQ-W8_4gyNL0XRN42kl-_NPfsfxw1552446aQrS-lgkro4qQKiRycwX2AfwzoexmxkgOVuJgXkFpVvMYZVhZJGA?key=ja85VqosmQ31-t5bI4Qfj0gY"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]DELIVER[/b][/p][p]Shoot the package into the mailbox and make sure it arrives on time. With a bit of aim and luck, it won’t get lost in space![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcPNSgp2tguycZ1RoDCF4jy22-aTK4ekgIGTsjtEqudnMvbn21ZWBk_ZuFjXZjoQjXiW7VVqQMAaTXC7EnlbBFFmn80UiVaxm1c_tl-6wWrEcjOuWD_iN3bmwnOZFGxlAggwAtpGQ?key=ja85VqosmQ31-t5bI4Qfj0gY"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Want to know more? Check out Underpacked! social media 🎥[/h3][p][/p][p]On our [url="https://linktr.ee/drunkenduckco"][u]social media[/u][/url] you will find the full delivery process of Underpacked![/p][p][/p][p][i]It’s in Spanish, but we’ve added subtitles in all the languages. Underpacked! is ready to reach every corner of the galaxy.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]And just before you go, check a look to our previous logbooks:[/p][list][*][p]Space logbook #00 | [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3587480/view/505078250120151791?l=english"][u]The Underpacked! lift off![/u][/url][/p][/*][*][p]Space logbook #01 | [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3587480/view/505078250120155018?l=english"][u]Creating a game: A galaxy-sized task[/u][/url][/p][/*][*][p]Space logbook #02 | [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3587480/view/505078875556940345?l=english"][u]Designing the cosmos[/u][/url][/p][/*][*][p]Space logbook #03 | [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3587480/view/570381806642140863?l=english"][u]Don’t panic: You Are Not Alone[/u][/url][/p][/*][*][p]Space logbook #04 | [url="https://steamcommunity.com/ogg/3587480/announcements/detail/505080786253250914?snr=2___"][u]The stars look very different today[/u][/url][/p][/*][*][p]Space logbook #05 | [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3587480/view/505080786253254089?l=spanish"][u]The entire universe is waiting on your delivery[/u][/url][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you, dear crewmate, for picking up this delivery! But this was just the first shipment, we’re heading back to work, and there are many surprise orders waiting to be delivered.
[/p][p]See you soon! (If the boss decides to pay us)[/p][p]Thanks for being part of the crew[/p][p]— [i]The Drunken Duck Co. team[/i][/p][p]
[/p]
